title: Algebraic dualizing complexes and their local normalization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use the ordinary derived category $D(A)$ of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $R\operatorname{Hom}_A$ as [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. An algebraic dualizing complex is an object $\Omega\in D(A)$ such that (i) $\Omega$ is isomorphic to a bounded complex of injective $A$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions], (ii) every $H^j(\Omega)$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and (iii) the scalar-action map $A[0]\to R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\Omega,\Omega)$ is an isomorphism. If $A$ is local with unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$, such a complex is normalized if $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\kappa[0],\Omega)\cong\kappa[0]$. Here $M[0]$ denotes a module in degree zero and $H^j$ denotes cohomology.
